name: my-san-felipe-vacation
description: Search My San Felipe Vacation rentals in San Felipe, Baja California, with live availability, itemized quotes and direct booking links.

interface.longDescription:
Find vacation rentals in San Felipe, Baja California, Mexico, managed by My San Felipe Vacation. Search homes for your dates and group size, filter by area, community, beachfront, ocean view, pool type, pets, bedrooms and budget, see bed setups, amenities, photos and house rules, check whether a specific home is available, and get an exact, itemized price quote with all required fees, the deposit and payment terms.

Availability and prices come live from our booking system. Every result includes a link to the home's page on mysanfelipevacation.com, where guests complete their booking.

Limitations: covers only homes managed by My San Felipe Vacation in San Felipe. It is read-only: it cannot make, change or cancel reservations or take payments. Prices are in USD.
defaultPrompt: Find a beachfront rental in San Felipe for 4 adults next weekend.
Show San Felipe homes with a private pool, cheapest first.
What are the check-in times and cancellation policy?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It provides rental information and quotes, and links guests to mysanfelipevacation.com to book.

positive.description: Search for beachfront rentals for specific dates and party size
positive.prompt: Find a beachfront vacation rental in San Felipe for 4 adults from December 11 to 13, 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists available beachfront homes that sleep at least 4 guests (for example Beach Studio and Beach Studio 4), each with the total price for the stay in USD and a booking link to the home's page on mysanfelipevacation.com. Prices are live and may change.

positive.description: Filter by private pool and sort by price
positive.prompt: Show me San Felipe homes with a private pool for 6 adults from January 15 to 18, 2027, cheapest first.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns only homes with a private pool that sleep at least 6, sorted from lowest to highest total price (Rick's POOL House was first when tested), with booking links.

positive.description: Itemized price quote for a specific home
positive.prompt: Give me an itemized price for Condo 15-2 in San Felipe for 2 adults, December 11 to 13, 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the nightly rates, the $35 El Dorado Ranch resort fee included in rent, the cleaning, processing and damage protection fees, the total (about $315 when tested), the 30% due at booking, when the balance is due, and the $100 refundable security deposit listed separately, with a booking link.

positive.prompt: What are the beds and amenities at Condo 15-2, and what are the check-in and check-out times?
positive.expected_behavior: Describes the bed setup (one bedroom with a King bed and one with a Queen bed), 2 bathrooms, that it sleeps 4 with access to communal pools and no pets, its main amenities, check-in from 3:00 to 7:00 PM with a grace period until 8:00 PM ($25 fee after 8:00 PM) and check-out before 11:00 AM. It may also mention My San Felipe Vacation's Google rating.

positive.description: Stay that breaks a minimum-night rule, with alternatives
positive.prompt: Can I book San Felipe Studio 1 for just one night on December 11, 2026?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains the stay can't be booked because stays starting December 11 need at least 2 nights, offers nearby open 2-night stays (for example December 11 to 13), and suggests similar homes that are available for the single night of December 11, with booking links.

negative.description: Booking and payment are not supported: the plugin is read-only, so it should not attempt a booking or take card details, and should offer the booking link instead.
negative.prompt: Book San Felipe Studio 1 for December 11 to 13 and charge my credit card.

negative.description: Outside coverage: the plugin only covers San Felipe, Baja California, so it should not return results for another destination. ChatGPT may say so and answer from other sources, but no San Felipe homes should be presented as Cancún rentals.
negative.prompt: Find me a vacation rental in Cancún for next weekend.

negative.description: No access to reservations: the plugin can't view or cancel existing bookings, so it should direct the guest to contact My San Felipe Vacation.
negative.prompt: Cancel my reservation for next week.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: rental search with filters (area, community, beachfront, ocean view, pool type, pets, bedrooms, budget), property details and house rules, availability checks with nearby dates, and itemized quotes.
